subject: [Encord] Coffee in Austin with founding team?
text:

       [NAME],

subject: Waste Metering™ CV stack
text:
Hi [NAME], 

      We recently worked on a project with Sewer AI and it reminded me of what you are solving at 
      RoadRunner. They were focused on real-time defect classification across cameras deployed in messy lighting and different pipe environments. 

      One problem we see at that scale: real-world data and edge cases outgrown open-source and internal tooling: annotation + QA quickly become the bottleneck. Results are less accurate models and slower iteration. 

      That's why they switched to us to consolidate curation, labeling, QA, and eval so models improve faster without adding manual overhead. 

      Would love to connect and hear about how you're approaching this. Open to a chat next week?

subject: Clinical AI eval
text:
Hi [NAME],

Building and evaluating E2E clinical agents is one of the hottest topics in
Healthcare AI now. Thought I'd reach out as my team have been working on
similar projects w/ Mayo clinic and Iterative Health.

Common challenges we help them solve are on the HITL that sits behind LLM
workflows: clinical data curation, multimodal annotation (EHR, NER, audio
transcription, chatbot history), eval pipelines on diagnostic predictions
etc.

Given you're leading clinical innovation at Curai, I think there's meaning
overlap to introduce Encord to you.

Would you be open to a quick intro call and compare notes?
